Facebook - Getting a 'like' or having a 'life'?

By: Jo Munnik | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Getting a 'like' or having a 'life' - we delve behind the screen into the world of Facebook and expose a web of deceit.

Summary:
Facebook is one of the largest online social media platforms in the world, with over 1'.3 billion users worldwide. It's purpose is to make it easy for you to connect and share with your family and friends online. But for many subscribers it serves as an escape, providing a platforms where you can reconstruct your identity and be whoever or wherever you want to be.. Chances are, your Facebook persona will get more likes than the real life version of you and that kind of affirmation can be addictive.

In this story we look into the different forms of lies that you may encounter on Facebook:

IN 2014 Zilla van den Born, a Dutch student, pretended to be on holiday in Bali for 5 weeks - she created her entire trip on Facebook and had all her friends and family believe that she was on holiday, when she actually never left her apartment.

We conduct a social experiment and expose how easy it is to fake a Facebook profile and connect with total strangers who are none the wiser.. Our profile is totally innocuous, but others are far more dangerous with greater consequences..

A catfish is someone who pretends to be someone they're not using Facebook or other social media to create false identities, particularly to pursue deceptive online romances or demand money.. Carina is a case study who fell victim to this.. We speak to her. (TBC)


We should also speak to Facebook to understand how you can protect yourself from deception..

Yolanda
Carina De Buys

Press Release:


Facebook – getting a like or having a life?
Facebook or Fakebook? As one of the largest social media platforms, Facebook has 1.3 billion users worldwide who connect with family and friends to share photos and experiences. But for some subscribers it offers an escape and the chance to ‘catfish’ - creating false identities, often to pursue online romance or demand money. Carte Blanche goes behind the screen to expose a web of deceit.
Producer: Jo Munnik
Presenter: Claire Mawisa

Script:


CATFISH DEFINITION: TEXT
A CATFISH IS SOMEONE WHO USES SOCIAL MEDIA TO CREATE FALSE IDENTITIES TO PURSUE DECEPTIVE ONLINE ROMANCES AND / OR EXTORT MONEY

FADE TO BLACK.

CLAIRE
DO YOU THINK THAT HE IS WHO HE SAYS HE IS ON FACEBOOK?
LIZ
I DON’T KNOW.. AT THAT STAGE I THOUGHT YES. BUT NOW I HAVE LOTS OF DOUBTS..
HE TOLD ME HE IS 28 YEARS OLD, HE LIVES IN INDIA. HIS NAME AND HIS SURNAME. THAT’S ABOUT WHAT I KNEW ABOUT HIM..

FACEBOOK STATS : GRAPHIC
• FACEBOOK IS THE WORLD’S LARGEST SOCIAL MEDIA NETWORKING PLATFORM
• IT HAS 1.4 BILLION ACTIVE GLOBAL USERS
• 22% OF THE SOUTH AFRICAN POPULATION IS ON FACEBOOK

CLAIRE LINK:
SOCIAL MEDIA AND FACEBOOK IN PARTICULAR IS ALL ABOUT CONNECTING WITH PEOPLE ACROSS THE WORLD.. BUT, DO YOU ACTUALLY KNOW WHO YOUR FACEBOOK FRIENDS ARE?
FACEBOOK REPORTEDLY HAS OVER 170 MILLION FAKE USERS WORLDWIDE AND THOSE ARE JUST THE ONES THEY ARE AWARE OF..

VO:
AMERICAN FOOTBALLER MANTI TE’O HAD A TWO YEAR LONG RELATIONSHIP WITH A GIRL WHO HE MET ONLINE. SHE DIED TRAGICALLY FROM LEUKEMIA. AFTER PUBLICLY DEDICATING THE SUCCESS OF HIS ATHLETIC CAREER TO HER, HE DISCOVERED THAT SHE HAD NEVER EXISTED. THE GIRL HE THOUGHT HE HAD LOVED AND LOST WAS ACTUALLY A 22 YEAR OLD MAN. HE HAD BEEN THE VICTIM OF CAT FISHING.

EMMA SADLEIR
EVERYBODY CAN PRETEND TO BE ANYONE.

VO
SOCIAL MEDIA LAWYER AND AUTHOR, EMMA SADLEIR, ADVISES PEOPLE DAILY ON THE RISKS OF THE ONLINE WORLD.





EMMA SADLEIR

IF YOU HAVEN’T MET THEM IN THE REAL WORLD, THEN YOU HAVE NO IDEA WHO YOU ARE TALKING TO. JUST BECAUSE THEY HAVE A FACEBOOK PROFILE AND A TWITTER PROFILE DOESN’T MEAN THAT PERSON EXISTS.

VO:
YET, MANY OF US ACCEPT FRIEND REQUESTS EVERY DAY FROM PEOPLE WE’VE NEVER MET IN THE REAL WORLD. LIKE LIZ, NOT HER REAL NAME, WHO JOINED FACEBOOK IN JANUARY THIS YEAR. SHE ACCEPTED A FRIEND REQUEST FROM A STRANGER NAMED JOSH, WHO WAS ABOUT TO DERAIL HER LIFE.

LIZ
I FELT LONELY BECAUSE MY HUSBAND WORKS LONG HOURS AND GOES TO SLEEP REALLY EARLY AT NIGHT. AND I WANTED SOMEBODY TO TALK TO. I MEAN, I’M NOT ONE OF THE PRETTIEST LADIES I KNOW. THAT THIS GUY THOUGHT THAT I WAS SPECIAL ENOUGH TO TALK TO.

VO:
FOR THREE WEEKS JOSH AND LIZ ENGAGED 3 TO 4 TIMES A DAY ON FACEBOOK. THEIR RACY CONVERSATIONS SOON TURNED UGLY. ….

LIZ
HE WOULD START BY ASKING WHAT ARE YOU WEARING, WHAT ARE YOU DOING.. TOUCH YOURSELF. I FEEL LIKE HAVING SEX.

EMMA SADLEIR
WHERE ALARM BELLS SHOULD START RINGING LOUDLY IS WHERE THE PERSON YOU ARE SPEAKING TO HAS ASKED YOU TO SEND THEM ANYTHING – GIFTS, MONEY, PHOTOS OF YOURSELF.

LIZ
AND HE SAID, HE WANTS SOME MONEY AND I MUST HELP HIM STEAL MONEY FROM MY HUSBAND.

VO:
WHEN SHE REFUSED, HE THREATENED HER.

LIZ:
AND THEN HE SAID HE WILL GET HOLD OF MY HUSBAND AND TELL HIM EVERYTHING.. AND HE WILL POST SOME THINGS ABOUT ME ON FACEBOOK AND HE KNOWS SOME PEOPLE IN SOUTH AFRICA WHO WILL COME AFTER US.. AND I GOT SO SCARED.


VO:
LIZ WAS SO EMOTIONALLY SCARRED THAT SHE ATTEMPTED TO COMMIT SUICIDE.

LIZ:
I GOT HOME, I SAID TO MY KIDS – LISTEN I LOVE YOU I TOOK SOME SLEEPING PILLS.. I WAS SO SCARED TO GO TO MY HUSBAND.

CLAIRE
IS LIZ’S SCENARIO UNIQUE?

EMMA SADLEIR
NO. THERE ARE PEOPLE WHO FIND THEMSELVES IN MUCH THE SAME PREDICAMENT AS LIZ ALL THE TIME AND THERE ARE NOTED CASE STUDIES ALL AROUND THE WORLD WHO SUFFER HARM BECAUSE THEY START SPEAKING TO PEOPLE AND THEY HAVE NO IDEA WHO THEY ARE IN THE REAL WORLD.

VO:
USING AN ACTRESS, CALLED LEE, WE CONDUCTED AN EXPERIMENT TO SEE HOW DIFFICULT IT WOULD BE TO CREATE A FAKE FACEBOOK PROFILE. TURNS OUT, IT’S PRETTY EASY.

LEE CREATED AN INNOCUOUS PROFILE USING A FALSE NAME. WITHIN 24 HOURS SHE HAD 70 FACEBOOK FRIENDS. ONLY 4 OF THOSE WERE PEOPLE SHE ACTUALLY KNEW. THE REST WERE STRANGERS.

THE PROFILE WAS ACTIVE FOR 30 HOURS BEFORE FACEBOOK SUSPECTED IT MAY BE DISINGENUOUS AND SUSPENDED IT FOR VIOLATING ITS REAL NAME POLICY.

EMMA
FACEBOOK THEORETICALLY SAYS THAT SOMEBODY CAN’T PRETEND TO BE SOMEONE ELSE ON SOCIAL MEDIA. OF COURSE IT HAPPENS ALL THE TIME.

VO:
AND EVEN IF YOU ARE USING YOUR REAL NAME YOU CAN STILL PLAY PRETEND..
LIKE MONIQUE, NOT HER REAL NAME, WHO USED FACEBOOK TO SEEK SEXUAL ATTENTION FROM MEN.

MONIQUE
I WAS UNHAPPY. I NEVER WANTED TO GET MARRIED. I GOT TO ATTENTION. THEN YOU POST ONE SEXY PHOTO ON FACEBOOK AND BOOM, YOU GET THOUSANDS OF REQUESTS.
IT WAS FUN. I’VE NEVER HAD SO MUCH ATTENTION IN 15, 20 YEARS.

CLAIRE
AND THE PERSON THAT YOU WERE ON FACEBOOK, IS THAT THE SAME PERSON SITTING IN FRONT OF ME RIGHT NOW?

MONIQUE
NO. I’VE LOST MYSELF COMPLETELY.

VO:
MONIQUE PROCEEDED TO HAVE 3 AFFAIRS WITH MARRIED MEN SHE MET ON FACEBOOK AND IS NOW MARRIED TO ONE OF THOSE MEN. INTERESTINGLY, THE FASTEST GROWING DEMOGRAPHIC ON FACEBOOK IS WOMEN OVER THE AGE OF 55.

CLAIRE
WHAT ARE WE SO DRAWN TO FACEBOOK – CONNECTIONS, AFFIRMATION, ESCAPISM?

KHAYA DLANGA
I THINK IT’S ALL THOSE THINGS.. FOR SOMEONE ELSE IT MAY BE ABOUT CONNECTION, OR FOR OTHERS ABOUT ESCAPING.

VO:
COMMUNICATIONS AND MEDIA SPECIALIST KHAYA DLANGA EXPLAINS OUR ATTRACTION TO SOCIAL MEDIA.

KHAYA DLANGA
YOU WANT PEOPLE TO THINK YOU ARE DOING BETTER THAN YOU ARE ACTUALLY DOING AND WANT OTHERS TO ENVY YOUR LIFE.

VO:
THINK ABOUT IT - HOW MUCH OF YOUR LIFE DO YOU SPEND ONLINE – WHETHER ON TWITTER, INSTAGRAM, SNAPCHAT OR FACEBOOK TAILORING AND PROMOTING YOUR ONLINE PERSONA.

EMMA SADLEIR
I THINK THAT EVERYBODY, EVEN THE MOST LEGITIMATE ACCOUNTS IS A PHOTO SHOPPED, SANITIZED, BEST VERSION PUT FORWARD, WE ARE ALL GUILTY OF IT. ..
WE ARE FEEDING A GENERATION OF DIGITAL NATIVES WHO DON’T KNOW LIFE, UNLESS IT IS THE LIFE LIVED ONLINE.

CLAIRE LINK
ZILLA VON DEN BORN IS A DUTCH STUDENT WHO USED FACEBOOK TO DEMONSTRATE JUST HOW EASY IT IS TO MANIPULATE WHAT WE SHOW ON SOCIAL MEDIA.. FOR 5 WEEKS SHE PRETENDED TO BE IN SOUTH EAST ASIA. IN REALITY, SHE WAS IN HER APARTMENT IN AMSTERDAM.

VO:
AS PART OF A UNIVERSITY ASSIGNMENT ZILLA UPDATED HER FACEBOOK STATUS AND UPLOADED PHOTO SHOPPED IMAGES DAILY. HER SOCIAL EXPERIMENT WAS A TREMENDOUS SUCCESS, and attracted THOUSANDS OF LIKES, SHARES AND COMMENTS. ZILLA’S EXPERIMENT MAY SOUND EXTREME, BUT IT’S WHAT MANY PEOPLE ARE DOING ON A DAILY BASIS – MERELY PLAYING A ROLE. AND, THE ONLINE STAGE PROVIDES INSTANT ACCESS TO A GLOBAL AUDIENCE.

CLAIRE:
DO YOU THINK WE ARE SOMETIMES COMPETING WITH ONE ANOTHER ON SOCIAL MEDIA PLATFORMS?

KHAYA:
I THINK PEOPLE DO THAT. THEY WANT TO SEE HOW MANY LIKES AM I GETTING OR HOW MANY FOLLOWERS DO I HAVE. WHEN YOU DON’T HAVE TOO MUCH GOING ON IN YOUR REAL LIFE THAT IS WHEN IT BECOMES IMPORTANT.

CLAIRE
DID YOU REPORT THIS INCIDENT AND THIS MAN TO FACEBOOK?

LIZ
NO, I DON’T KNOW HOW TO REPORT HIM OR ANYTHING, SO I DIDN’T..

EMMA SADLEIR
THE FIRST THING YOU DO IS REPORT IT TO THE PLATFORM. PRIORITY NO 1 IS TO GET THAT CONTENT DELETED. THE SECOND THING YOU DO IS EXPLORE WHAT LEGAL OPTIONS ARE AVAILABLE TO YOU. THERE ARE A LOT OF RESOURCES AVAILABLE TO YOU ON THE INTERNET.
IF SOMEONE HAD GONE TO ANY KIND OF LENGTH TO CREATE A FAKE ACCOUNT THEN THEY ARE UNLAWFULLY INTERCEPTING YOUR DATA AND YOU CAN LAY A CRIMINAL CHARGE AGAINST THEM.

VO:
LIZ IS NOW IN THERAPY AND TAKING HER OFFLINE LIFE DAY BY DAY, WITH HER HUSBAND’S SUPPORT.

CLAIRE
WHAT ADVICE DO YOU HAVE FOR OTHER WOMEN IN THE SAME SITUATION AS YOU?

LIZ
I JUST WANT TO SAY TO PEOPLE, BE CAREFUL WHAT YOU SAY ON FACEBOOK AND WHO YOU TALK TO.. IF YOU DON’T KNOW THE PERSON, RATHER DON’T TALK TO THEM.


PROMO 1: 10”
VO: FACEBOOK REPORTEDLY HAS OVER 170 MILLION USERS WITH FAKE PROFILES. DO YOU REALLY KNOW WHO YOU ARE ENGAGING WITH ON SOCIAL MEDIA?

PROMO 2: 15 ”
LIZ
HE SAID HE KNEW SOME PEOPLE IN SA WHO WOULD HURT MY FAMILY AND MY KIDS AND I WAS SO SO SCARED.
VO: CATFISH FAKE IDENTITIES ON SOCIAL MEDIA TO PERPETRATE DECEIT OR CRIME – AND THEY ARE ALL TOO COMMON ONLINE.

PROMO 3: 15”
VO: TO WHAT EXTEND DO WE USE SOCIAL MEDIA TO MANIPULATE REALITY?
EMMA: We are feeding the beast. We don’t know a life, other than the life lived online.

PROMO 3: 10”
VO: HAS THE WORLD OF SOCIAL MEDIA BECOME THE ULTIMATE PLATFORM FOR DECEPTION?
KHAYA DLANGA
PROBABLY THE BIGGEST DANGER IS TALKING TO SOMEONE YOU THINK YOU KNOW.

PIECE TO CAMERA - PROMO 1
We delve behind the screen into the world of social media / Facebook and expose a web of deceit.. Carte Blanche this Sunday at 7

PIECE TO CAMERA - PROMO 2
Getting a like or having a life .. Are we putting more effort into our online personas and relationships than our real life ones? Carte Blanche this Sunday at 7

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Getting a 'like' or having a 'life' - we delve behind the screen into the world of Facebook and expose a web of deceit.
metadata.Summary: Facebook is one of the largest online social media platforms in the world, with over 1'.3 billion users worldwide. It's purpose is to make it easy for you to connect and share with your family and friends online. But for many subscribers it serves as an escape, providing a platforms where you can reconstruct your identity and be whoever or wherever you want to be.. Chances are, your Facebook persona will get more likes than the real life version of you and that kind of affirmation can be addictive. In this story we look into the different forms of lies that you may encounter on Facebook: IN 2014 Zilla van den Born, a Dutch student, pretended to be on holiday in Bali for 5 weeks - she created her entire trip on Facebook and had all her friends and family believe that she was on holiday, when she actually never left her apartment. We conduct a social experiment and expose how easy it is to fake a Facebook profile and connect with total strangers who are none the wiser.. Our profile is totally innocuous, but others are far more dangerous with greater consequences.. A catfish is someone who pretends to be someone they're not using Facebook or other social media to create false identities, particularly to pursue deceptive online romances or demand money.. Carina is a case study who fell victim to this.. We speak to her. (TBC) We should also speak to Facebook to understand how you can protect yourself from deception..
